16.en: The stars are distant and lost, but we must walk the paths to them and spread our blessings. For the day will come when the stars awake, and then they will come to us.

44.en: Their Patriarch senses that the greater Hive Mind is yet distant, and so their focus has been on spreading to other worlds.

52.en: The cult uses its influence to infect pilgrims on @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.0g60Fj0fRMDfzYGB]{Macharia} who have arrived from other worlds. Some ships leave bearing @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-actors.Actor.fZRrr5DJMuUoveZe]{Acolyte Hybrids} among the faithful, while others carry whole clutches of @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.KvLrPAQ0gmIWSvfX]{Purestrain Genestealers} hidden within their hulls.

62.en: The shrine world of @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.0g60Fj0fRMDfzYGB]{Macharia} is a beautiful jewel of the faithful in the @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.0g60Fj0fRMDfzYGB]{Donia Magna} system. Far from prying eyes, a blasphemous secret profanes this sacred world. The most zealous and stalwart members of the @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.6hX0E9XlPUoRaDaQ.JournalEntryPage.HURMpEU0Nnc93Ocv]{Adeptus Ministorum} fail to recognise the unholy cult that hides within the shrine’s depths.

66.en: The Pilgrim's Path is a small @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#tyranids]{Genestealer Cult} brought to @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.0g60Fj0fRMDfzYGB]{Macharia} by infected pilgrims from a world now long since claimed by the @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#tyranids]{Tyranid} Hive Fleet. The pilgrims established themselves among the faithful of Macharia, never straying far from the most important places of worship. They target pilgrims who, often caught up in the rapture of walking the holy ground of Macharia, are unobservant to the danger. Dragged off and infected by the Genestealer’s Kiss, these unfortunates are left with the powerful urge to return to their place of birth to spread the curse, often cutting their pilgrimage short to do so.

70.en: There, they settle back into their lives and begin the horrific cycle of infection anew. Often these nascent cults are undirected, but by the fourth generation, @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.KvLrPAQ0gmIWSvfX]{Purestrain Genestealers} are born to hybrid parents and, if no other has arrived, one will undergo the biological processes required for it to arise to the status of Patriarch. Once the cult has grown in strength, the true work of preparing the world for the arrival of @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#tyranids]{Tyranid} Hive Fleet can begin in earnest.

74.en: This too would have been the fate of @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.0g60Fj0fRMDfzYGB]{Macharia}, but either by a quirk of the Patriarch of the Pilgrim’s Path, or through the cunning intelligence of the greater hive mind, this has not been so. The cult here has kept a low profile, and benefited greatly from the world’s status as a nexus of faith for the sector’s many pilgrims. Many who seek to follow in the footsteps of the Macharian Crusade begin their long pilgrimage here, while others merely to see where @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.X5EFP7IgIUx6CaBW]{Saint Macharius} began his long and storied career in the Emperor’s service. Regardless of the reasons, all provide a suitable vector for the cult to spread its xenos taint.

88.en: Though modest by the standard of some infestations, the cult’s members are as dedicated as any other, and perhaps more practised in the art of subtle sabotage and infiltration than most. The cult’s Biophagus, @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-actors.Actor.ZVtbub70IiLYQm8u]{Gantus Black}, is especially well-practised in evading the Imperium’s methods of detecting his brothers and sisters. He provides outgoing ‘pilgrims’ with various tinctures and elixirs that confound the biological auguries that are sometimes employed to screen populations for xenos taint by those who know to look for such things, chiefly the Inquisition and certain Magi Biologis of the @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.6hX0E9XlPUoRaDaQ.JournalEntryPage.9frbPZ9v3lFR9Kva]{Adeptus Mechanicus}.

92.en: Though the cult has fewer resources than most, they are not without the means to destroy any threats to their nest. Hidden beneath the @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.0g60Fj0fRMDfzYGB]{Shrine of Macharius Ascendant} is a warren of tunnels which grew out of a Ministorum Arch-Deacon’s tomb centuries prior. These bunkers are home to hundreds of the Pilgrim's Path’s sons and daughters, with those no longer able to pass among the common masses confined to the lowest levels, and those not so blessed occupying the upper levels. All are willing to die for the cult, armed mainly with flamers procured from the faithful seeking a blessing before departing on crusade.

100.en: The cult’s plots move slowly, spreading their taint to other worlds by means of pilgrims. This might come to the Inquisition’s attention in a number of ways — a pattern of emergent cults might arise from a single infested pilgrimage departing @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.0g60Fj0fRMDfzYGB]{Macharia} for other worlds, or evidence of the cult might be found in Macharia itself. Should the Path's increased ability to escape detection by means of the cult’s biochemicals be discovered, perhaps during a routine inspection of a pilgrim’s belongings, this will quickly be identified as a novel threat worthy of the Inquisition’s attention. It is already difficult enough to detect a @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#tyranids]{Genestealer Cult} — the ability to defy even those few techniques known to exist would be a worrying development.

104.en: If the cult were discovered, it may well attempt to escape @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.0g60Fj0fRMDfzYGB]{Macharia} rather than make a pointless stand. They maintain a number of reliable members within Macharia’s voidport for just this reason, on standby to smuggle even the cult’s Patriarch aboard a voidship should the need arise.

112.en: The very presence of a @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#tyranids]{Genestealer Cult} on Macharia is the Path’s most carefully guarded secret, with the location and techniques of the @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-actors.Actor.ZVtbub70IiLYQm8u]{Biophagus}’ laboratory a close second. This facility would be a worthy prize for any Inquisition acolyte to acquire intact, for in finding ways to masque the presence of the Genestealer’s curse within the blood of a victim, Gantus was forced to profile several of the prominent biomarkers of infection. In the hands of a sufficiently skilled Tech-Priest, those markers not already known to the Inquisition could be revealed, allowing new ways to detect the curse in a population.
